LanguageData.VGE_DamagedSubstructure.label: damaged Hellion deck plating
LanguageData.VGE_DamagedSubstructure.description: A warped section of Hellion deck plating and support truss. The reactor's lift field still grips it, but another heavy impact will make it collapse completely.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipSubscaffold.label: Hellion scaffold
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipSubscaffold.description: A lightweight scaffold used to extend and service a Hellion airframe. It cannot support buildings, slows movement, and does not count against the aircraft's deck-plating limit.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidSubstructure.label: robot-platform deck plating
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidSubstructure.description: A lightweight truss-and-deck structure manufactured by a pre-War robot platform. Anything resting on it can be held by the platform reactor's lift field.
